annotations.title: 会社名から法人を探す

description: Find Japanese companies (法人) by name and return candidate corporate numbers (法人番号). Use this when the user gives a company name instead of a number, e.g. 「トヨタ自動車」「㈱サンプル 大阪」「sample shoji」. Name variants are absorbed automatically (株式会社/㈱/(株), full-width/half-width, spaces), so pass the name as the user wrote it; do not guess a 13-digit number. Narrow with prefecture when the user mentions a place. Results are ranked by score (0-1). If several candidates look plausible, ask the user which one they mean (show name and prefecture) instead of picking one. Then call bango_get_company with the chosen corporate_number for address and invoice status. Each call uses 1 API request from the user's Bango API quota.

company_name.description: 会社名（一部でも可）。例: 「サンプル商事」「株式会社サンプル」

exact.description: true にすると表記ゆれを吸収したうえでの完全一致だけを返す。既定は部分一致（false）

post_code.description: 郵便番号（7桁、ハイフン可）で絞り込む

prefecture.description: 都道府県で絞り込む。「大阪」「大阪府」「27」「osaka」のどれでも可

name: bango_find_company
